text:
Rhea Kapoor: opening Orbit POC perf thread. customer target = sustained 300 qps (short replies) with ~10% embed calls and occasional 1.5k+ token contexts. ask: fp16 vs ptq-int8 vs awq-int8 runs, plus one mixed embed soak. can infra run this week?
Omar Haddad: yes us-west2 dedicated pool available. need 1k-session corpus (or we synth). will enable prefix caching for warm runs. suggest 8 active slots + 2 spare for headroom.
Gwen Li: test plan: 3m ramp, 20m steady @300, 5m embed soak, 5m cooldown. capture p50/p95/p99, cold-tail traces, kv-cache hit, GPU util, and token throughput. we'll do cold and warm variants.
infra-bot: provisioning cluster/dedicated/us-west2/slotset-14 image=redwood-runtime:2026-06-02-rc status=allocating.
Rhea Kapoor: security asked for HSM-backed KMS + key zeroing proof. security-team can you confirm what we can include in the PDF?
security-team: confirmable — Private + Dedicated support customer-managed KMS with HSM option. key zeroing on teardown is documented; we'll attach a short appendix and SOC2 reference.
Omar Haddad: pre-run quick estimates: fp16 p95 ~200ms, ptq-int8 p95 ~230ms with extra jitter, awq-int8 p95 ~175ms but watch p99 spikes on cold. cost ballpark: ptq ~0.6x, awq ~0.5x.
Gwen Li: running fp16 baseline now. command: ```loadtest --corpus s3://poc/orbit/1k.json --target 300 --ramp 3m --steady 20m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant fp16 --cache-prefix --output /artifacts/orbit/4309876543/fp16.csv```
infra-bot: run complete -> /artifacts/orbit/4309876543/fp16.csv status=success
Gwen Li: fp16 smoke: p95=197ms, p99=420ms (cold tails), kv-hit=71%, GPU util avg=60%.
Gwen Li: ptq run done -> /artifacts/orbit/4309876543/ptq.csv p95=237ms, p99=540ms, kv-hit=67%, GPU util=48%.
Gwen Li: awq run done -> /artifacts/orbit/4309876543/awq.csv p95=179ms, p99=500ms with a few cold spikes ~650ms, kv-hit=74%, GPU util=36%. eval (50-case): 2 cases >4% accuracy drop, hallucination delta +1.2%.
Rhea Kapoor: great. can someone assemble a 1-pg PDF: bullets, heatmaps, CSVs, cost per 1M tokens for each quant, and the security appendix? target EOD. recommend awq-int8 + prefix caching + canary to fp16 for >1.2k token sessions. :thumbsup:
